comment: Appendix F's "Business Rule Enforcement" capability validates that authoring and publication actions conform to governance policy. The detailed SGI capability set does not explicitly include runtime enforcement of governed constraints on data instances. That distinction matters because governance of an artefact does not by itself ensure that data produced or exchanged against that artefact conforms to it.

public.text: Appendix F's "Business Rule Enforcement" capability validates that authoring and publication actions conform to governance policy. The detailed SGI capability set does not explicitly include runtime enforcement of governed constraints on data instances. That distinction matters because governance of an artefact does not by itself ensure that data produced or exchanged against that artefact conforms to it.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a capability under a suitable SGI category (e.g. Consumption or Monitoring): "Runtime constraint enforcement — machine-checkable validation of data instances against the applicable governed model at the point of use, distinct from authoring and publication governance."
